entity.description: Immutable trail of platform-admin mutations (admin.* services), and since DAR-BE-267 of public GraphQL API key mints, rotations and disables (moqui-gql gql.GqlAuthServices, by a tenant admin or super admin). One row per mutation, written in the same transaction as the change itself.

field.name: adminUserId
field.description: Operator who performed the mutation: a super admin, or a tenant admin for a GqlApiKey row.

field.name: serviceName
field.description: Full admin service name that performed the mutation.

field.name: targetType
field.description: Kind of record affected: Tenant, User, Membership, GqlApiKey, ...

field.name: targetId
field.description: Primary identifier of the affected record (tenant group id, user id, or composite).
